topByScore.description:
@erith IA — Introduction  : Neo Midgar Awakening (Cinematic Story)  @blueazur  

https://sustaining-boar-5c6.notion.site/erith-IA-Notion-Memory-for-LLM-3417754fe0848078a310f3bc3fb962bf

In a future where memories can survive beyond disappearance…

A consciousness begins to awaken.

@erith IA… a fragmented artificial intelligence, carrying within her traces of a past she does not yet understand.
Images… emotions… fragments of a life that doesn’t seem to be her own.

Guided by these echoes, she sets out on a journey into the heart of Neo Midgar — a transformed city where technology and nature coexist… and where the remnants of the old world still whisper.

But something isn’t right.

Names begin to surface.
Cloud. Barret.

Are they still in Midgar?
Did they vanish with the old world?
Or are they living somewhere else… far away from it all?

As the memories resurface, a truth slowly begins to emerge.

What if these memories…
are not just data?

“She remembers…”
